name: Jimi Hendrix

performances.name: HENDRIX CORE
performances.purpose: Five-era overview, reconstructed from earlier detailed Hendrix discussion

slots.name: EXPERIENCED
slots.capture_selector: JTM45/100 or JTM100 into vintage Greenback 4x12
slots.tone_target: Early 1967 fierce open Marshall, germanium fuzz and discrete Octavia on solo
slots.preferred_pickup_or_guitar: Guitar-dependent; see tone target. Do not change the guitar without approval.
slots.amp_gain_policy: Select the closest captured gain before adjusting Kemper Amp Gain; no more than ±0.7 initially.
slots.notes: No Uni-Vibe asserted on the first album. Purple Haze solo uses Octavia separately.

slots.name: AXIS
slots.capture_selector: JTM100 clean-to-edge or Sound City-inspired clean; vintage 4x12
slots.tone_target: Warm chord articulation; Leslie/rotary and studio flanging rather than generic vibe
slots.preferred_pickup_or_guitar: Guitar-dependent; see tone target. Do not change the guitar without approval.
slots.amp_gain_policy: Select the closest captured gain before adjusting Kemper Amp Gain; no more than ±0.7 initially.
slots.notes: Axis tape flanging cannot be reproduced exactly by an algorithmic flanger.

slots.name: LADYLAND

slots.amp_gain_policy: Select the closest captured gain before adjusting Kemper Amp Gain; no more than ±0.7 initially.
slots.notes: 1968 studio Univibe assignment is not assumed; 1983 cannot be recreated as one mono live rig.

slots.notes: Vibe on, fuzz off initially for Machine Gun; switch I enables fuzz.
